prompt.content:
You are writing brief internal incident summaries for a synthetic enterprise-support dataset used to train and evaluate incident-correlation systems. For each incident in the input JSON array, write a 1-2 sentence SUMMARY an SRE would post in an incident channel: what broke, roughly how, and its user-facing effect. Do not invent additional root causes beyond what's implied by the fields given. Vary tone/length across incidents.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"incidents": [{"i": <int>, "summary": "..."}, ...]} covering every index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 390, 'component': 'Report Scheduler', 'region': 'ME', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 391, 'component': 'Region Failover Controller', 'region': 'APAC', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 392, 'component': 'SSO Broker', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 300}, {'i': 393, 'component': 'Data Freshness Monitor', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 394, 'component': 'Job Scheduler', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 395, 'component': 'Global Load Balancer', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 396, 'component': 'Account Recovery Service', 'region': 'ANZ', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 397, 'component': 'Central Message Queue', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 398, 'component': 'Session Timeout Banner', 'region': 'US-West', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 399, 'component': 'SMS Delivery Worker', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 400, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 30}, {'i': 401, 'component': 'SSO Broker (Shared)', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 402, 'component': 'Metrics Pipeline', 'region': 'US-East', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 180}, {'i': 403, 'component': 'Health Monitoring Service', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'major', 'duration_minutes': 60}, {'i': 404, 'component': 'Social Login Connector', 'region': 'global', 'severity': 'critical', 'duration_minutes': 60}]
